configuration.prompt: Write the numbers from 1 to 100 in order, separated by commas, and do not stop early.

changes: Keep the Qwen target-synchronized MTP attention lane persistent across prompt and decode tokens.
Verify 2 through 16 target rows layerwise with specialized 4, 8, and 16-row exact Q4_K CUDA kernels.
Advance DeltaNet rows causally and publish an accepted recurrent boundary without replay.
Allocate verify rebase journals on demand so non-MTP sessions retain only three recurrent state copies.
Preserve the MTP KV lane when its capacity grows and disable MTP for image-conditioned embedding overrides.
Expose speculative acceptance and rollback counters in benchmark JSON.
Replace scalar CUDA RMSNorm with the same deterministic eight-chain accumulation executed concurrently, followed by a parallel output write.
Use deterministic eight-chain F32 matvec and 2-16 row matmul kernels for Qwen DeltaNet projections and MTP verification.
Pack eight independent exact Q4_K or Q5_K output-row warps into each CUDA block and replace the shared-memory reduction with an AVX2-order warp shuffle.
Decode Q5_K scale and minimum pairs once per warp and broadcast them without changing the per-row FMA order.
Compile and freshness-check the dense F32 CUDA source and PTX in the hosted CUDA workflow.

depth_6.decision: Retain as the fastest measured depth for this workload; do not generalize it to a product default without the multi-prompt tuner.

depth_7.decision: Superseded by depth 6 after the dense F32 target and verifier optimization.

depth_15.decision: Rejected because deeper verification regressed against depth 7.

controlled_same_host_ab.mtp_interpretation: The -0.10% mean change and +0.08% median change are measurement noise; MTP throughput was unchanged.

rejected_experiments.name: generic non-recurrent Q4_K dispatch
rejected_experiments.decision: Rejected despite identical 128-token output because throughput regressed by about 47%.

rejected_experiments.name: two output rows per warp
rejected_experiments.decision: Rejected despite bit-exact CUDA parity because register pressure and serialized row work more than halved throughput.

same_gpu_reference.interpretation: The 50 tok/s objective is feasible on this GPU and artifact, but XRT has not reached it; the remaining gap is in XRT's target CUDA kernel stack.

limitations: The best retained XRT result is 37.123 tok/s, not the 50 tok/s objective.
One throughput prompt and one raw-generation parity prompt do not constitute production quality admission.
The measured best draft depth is workload-dependent; recursive MTP acceptance was substantially lower on an open-ended raw prompt.
MTP prefix snapshots are not yet stored, so MTP sessions deliberately bypass the shared prefix cache.
The workspace strict Clippy gate still fails on pre-existing SIMD/MSRV and missing-safety-documentation debt; cargo test --workspace passes.
